validated_results.title: Association of self-reported consumption of cooked meat, fish, seafood and eggs with prostate cancer risk among Nigerians.
validated_results.reason: This case-control study reports the multivariable-adjusted odds ratio for prostate cancer risk associated with egg consumption comparing the highest to lowest intake quartiles among Nigerian men.

extraction.population: Men aged 40 years and older recruited from community and hospital clinics in Southern Nigeria

sample_size.excerpt: 127(20.1%) of the controls were recruited from the clinics and 293(79.9%) from the community. The characteristics of the 324 with their FFQ information in the database are presented in Table 2 .

effect_size.excerpt: PCa risk trend comparing 4 th to 1 st quartile annual intake was significant for red and organ meat, p < 0.04, with OR(95% CI) 1.74(0.59–5.17), 0.94(0.34–2.64), 1.16(0.50–2.68), and 1.18(0.50–2.81) for red meat, organ meat, fish and egg respectively (Table 4 ).

confidence_interval.excerpt: PCa risk trend comparing 4 th to 1 st quartile annual intake was significant for red and organ meat, p < 0.04, with OR(95% CI) 1.74(0.59–5.17), 0.94(0.34–2.64), 1.16(0.50–2.68), and 1.18(0.50–2.81) for red meat, organ meat, fish and egg respectively (Table 4 ).

comparison.excerpt: Odds ratios and 95% confidence interval (CI) for prostate cancer risk comparing lowest to highest quartiles of dietary intake of meat, fish, seafood and eggs in the Nigerian study population

design.excerpt: This study examined the association of self-reported consumption of cooked meat, fish, sea food, and eggs with PCa risk among Nigerians in a case-control design.

timing.excerpt: This study examined the association of self-reported consumption of cooked meat, fish, sea food, and eggs with PCa risk among Nigerians in a case-control design.

continent.excerpt: Men 40 years and older recruited by door-to-door invitation from two rural and two urban communities of Edo and Delta states of Southern Nigeria, were screened for PCa by PSA blood test and DRE examination.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Trained interviewers obtained informed consent and completed the personal information questionnaire, and a food frequency inventory based on the Block FFQ modified by the addition of Nigerian foods and culturally appropriate serving portions (Figure 1 ) for each participnats.
